description: Hand-derived RunReport fixture (plan 03): 6 closed trades + 7 equity points, starting_equity 10000, timeframe 1H.
derivation: Counts: 6 trades = 4 BREAKOUT + 2 MEAN_REVERSION = 3 BUY + 3 SELL; results 3 WIN / 2 LOSS / 1 BREAKEVEN -> win_rate = 3/6 = 0.5 (D8: BREAKEVEN counts against). Positive pnl: 300+100+30+450 = 880 (gross win, includes the +30 BREAKEVEN by convention: profit factor is over signed pnl, not result labels); negative pnl: 150+250 = 400 (gross loss) -> profit_factor = 880/400 = 2.2. expectancy_r = (2.0-1.0+1.0+0.2-1.25+3.0)/6 = 3.95/6 = 0.658333333. avg_win = 880/4 = 220, max_win = 450; avg_loss = -(400/2) = -200, max_loss = -250 (most negative). Holding hours per trade: 8,4,6,10,12,10 -> mean 50/6 = 8.333333333. R histogram (0.5-wide bins on [-2,3), open ends): -1.25 -> [-1.5,-1); -1.0 -> [-1,-0.5) (lo edge inclusive); 0.2 -> [0,0.5); 1.0 -> [1,1.5); 2.0 -> [2,2.5); 3.0 -> >=3. BREAKOUT subset (trades 1,2,4,6): gross win 300+30+450=780, gross loss 150 -> pf 5.2; expectancy (2.0-1.0+0.2+3.0)/4 = 1.05; holds (8+4+10+10)/4 = 8. MEAN_REVERSION subset (3,5): pf 100/250 = 0.4; expectancy (1.0-1.25)/2 = -0.125; holds (6+12)/2 = 9. Series, peak starts at 10000: 10100 new peak; 10050,9950 in drawdown (streak 2, dd_abs max 10100-9950 = 150, dd_pct 150/10100 = 1.485148515%); 10200 new peak; 10150,10100 in drawdown (streak 2, dd 100 < 150); 10250 new peak -> longest streak 2. final 10250, return (10250-10000)/10000 = 2.5%. Sharpe: 7 per-bar returns r_i = eq_i/eq_{i-1} - 1 with eq_0 := 10000 (first return 0.01, 10050/10100-1 = -0.004950495..., etc.); mean = 0.0036069000464, sample std (ddof=1) = 0.0131187291036; annualization sqrt(365*24) for 1H bars -> sharpe = mean/std*sqrt(8760) = 25.7332356090 (mean/std hand-checked to 4 significant digits, full precision from the formula per the indicator-fixture spot-check rule).
